elsewhere.note: You shall have a trowel among your weapons. It shall be, when you relieve yourself, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover your excrement;
You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing.…
You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”
